info.name: LoungeAccessSystem API
info.description:
# Airport Lounge Access System - API test collection

## Setup
1. Start the app from a **fresh JVM**: `mvn spring-boot:run` (H2 is in-memory, demo data is re-seeded on every start).
2. Postman -> **Import** `LoungeAccessSystem.postman_collection.json` and `LoungeAccessSystem.postman_environment.json`; select the *LoungeAccessSystem - Local* environment.
3. Credentials are HTTP Basic `reception` / `lounge@123` (collection-level auth, change in the environment if you changed `lounge.security.*`).

## Running
* **Collection Runner** (recommended): run all folders in order, delay 0 ms, *Persist variables* off. Every request has tests; the whole run should be green.
* **Manual**: open a request, read its *Description* (purpose, preconditions, steps, expected result), press **Send**, check **Test Results**.
* **Folder 09 uploads files** from `samples/statements/`. Set Postman *Settings -> General -> Working directory* to the project root (or re-select the files in each request's Body tab). Newman: `newman run postman/LoungeAccessSystem.postman_collection.json -e postman/LoungeAccessSystem.postman_environment.json --working-dir .`. Folder 09 is stateless and can run on its own, in any order, any number of times.
* Folders 00-08 are order-dependent: tests store pass tokens in collection variables (`passToken_*`) and later folders consume them, and approvals consume quota/vouchers.
* **Re-running** the whole collection needs an app restart (quota, vouchers and passes are real state). Before restarting, you can also reset the collection variables `passToken_*`.

## Coverage map
| Folder | Verifies |
|---|---|
| 00 | App up, OpenAPI public, 401 without/with wrong credentials |
| 01 | Axis 3-month spend rule, exclusions (fuel/cash/wallet), new-card exception, idempotent re-issue |
| 02 | HDFC debit: spend + voucher (missing / malformed / unknown / other card / used / expired / valid), single-use voucher |
| 03 | HDFC credit tiers: Infinia unlimited, Millennia quota, Regalia Gold approve |
| 04 | Generic fallback (ICICI) and UNSUPPORTED_CARD (Kotak) |
| 05 | BIN lookup, CARD_NOT_FOUND, CUSTOMER_MISMATCH, bean validation, malformed JSON |
| 06 | Full quota exhaustion on a 3-visit card |
| 07 | Redeem happy path, double redeem, wrong lounge, unknown token, validation |
| 08 | Analytics: totals, rates, denial breakdown, banks, tiers, peak hours, parameter validation |
| 09 | **Statement analysis**: upload Aug/Sep/Oct statements -> eligibility for Nov, why / why not, and the spend needed in Nov to qualify for Dec (Axis rolling window, HDFC quarterly window, new-card exception, quota, missing months, duplicates, text/PDF, validation, security) |

## Manual-only scenarios (not automatable in one run)
* **Password-protected PDF statement**: attach the PDF as a `statements` file and add the text field `pdfPassword`. A wrong/missing password returns 400 `...is password protected`. PDF text extraction is best-effort (layouts differ per bank); the response lists `files[].transactionsParsed` and `linesSkipped` so you can verify the parse, and CSV is always the most reliable input.
* **Default target month**: omit `targetMonth` and the API evaluates *next month* relative to the server clock (Asia/Kolkata).
* **Expired pass (HTTP 410)**: start with `--lounge.pass.validity-minutes=1`, run 1.1, wait 61 seconds, run 7.4 -> 410 Gone with *Pass expired*. The quota is released automatically (re-run 1.1 -> new pass, `visitsRemaining` back to 1).
* **Blocked / expired card (CARD_INACTIVE)**: in the H2 console (`/h2-console`, JDBC URL `jdbc:h2:mem:loungedb`, user `sa`) run `UPDATE cards SET active = FALSE WHERE last4 = '0011';` then run 1.1 -> `CARD_INACTIVE`.
* **Quarter / month boundaries**: demo data is generated relative to today. To test boundaries, insert rows into `spend_history` with dates on the first/last day of the window and re-run the relevant request.
* **Concurrency**: fire request 6.1 twice in parallel (Runner with iterations is sequential; use two Postman windows or `curl &`) - the card row lock guarantees quota is never over-consumed.

## Test-data cheat sheet
| customerId | PAN | Scenario |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 4147200000000011 | Axis ACE qualifying |
| 2 | 4147200000000029 | Axis ACE new card |
| 3 | 4147200000000037 | Axis ACE low spend |
| 4 | 4386100000000013 | HDFC Platinum Debit (vouchers 482915037261 valid, 719304286150 expired, 260481937502 used) |
| 5 | 4386100000000021 | HDFC Platinum Debit low spend (voucher 530918274466) |
| 6 | 4386200000000019 | HDFC Infinia |
| 7 | 5241900000000012 | HDFC Millennia, quota used |
| 8 | 5241910000000010 | HDFC Regalia Gold |
| 9 | 6521000000000012 | ICICI Coral |
| 10 | 4000100000000018 | Kotak (unsupported) |

item.name: 00 - Smoke & Security
item.description: Run first. Confirms the app is up, Swagger is reachable and the API is protected by HTTP Basic.

request.description:
**Purpose**
Verify the service is running and OpenAPI docs are public.

**Preconditions**
Application started with `mvn spring-boot:run` (port 8080).

**Steps**
1. Send the request without credentials.

**Expected result**
200 and an OpenAPI document containing the three lounge/analytics paths.

**Purpose**
Prove the business API cannot be called anonymously.

**Preconditions**
Application running.

**Steps**
1. Send the request with **No Auth** (already overridden on this request).

**Expected result**
401 Unauthorized.

**Purpose**
Prove bad credentials are refused.

**Preconditions**
Application running.

**Steps**
1. Send the request with a deliberately wrong Basic password (set on this request).

**Expected result**
401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 01 - Axis Bank (spend-linked, 3 months)
item.description: Axis rule: >= INR 50,000 qualifying spend in the preceding 3 full calendar months (cash, wallet reload and fuel excluded). New-card exception waives spend until the end of (issue month + 3). Quota 2 visits per quarter.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description:
**Purpose**
Customer 1 spent 35,000 + 18,000 + 9,000 = 62,000 in the preceding 3 months.

**Preconditions**
Fresh application start (demo data loaded). Authentication is inherited from the collection (HTTP Basic using `{{username}}` / `{{password}}`).

**Steps**
1. Open the request body: card `{{pan_axis_ok}}`, customer `{{cust_axis_ok}}`, lounge `{{loungeId}}`.
2. Click **Send**.
3. Check the **Test Results** tab - all tests must pass.
4. The pass token is stored in the collection variable `passToken_axis` (used later by the redeem tests).

**Expected result**
`eligible=true`, `visitsRemaining=1` (2 per quarter, this entry uses one), `loungePassToken` = `LP-...`.

item.name: 1.2 Axis ACE - same card, same lounge again -> same pass (idempotent)

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 (a business outcome is always returned as 200)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("same pass re-issued (idempotent, no extra visit consumed)", () => pm.expect(j.loungePassToken).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("passToken_axis")));

request.description:
**Purpose**

**Steps**

2. Compare `loungePassToken` with the one from 1.1 (test does this automatically).

**Expected result**
`eligible=true` and the **same** token; `visitsRemaining` stays 1.

item.name: 08 - Analytics
item.description: Run last so the numbers reflect every attempt made above plus the seeded history. Window = last N hours (default 24). 'approved' includes redeemed passes.

exec: pm.test("denial counts add up to denied", () => pm.expect(Object.values(s.denialsByReason).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)).to.eql(s.denied));
pm.test("HDFC and AXIS appear in bank distribution", () => { const banks = s.byBank.map(b=>b.bank); pm.expect(banks).to.include.members(["HDFC","AXIS"]); });

pm.test("topCardTiers has at most 5 entries, sorted desc", () => { pm.expect(s.topCardTiers.length).to.be.at.most(5); for (let i=1;i<s.topCardTiers.length;i++) pm.expect(s.topCardTiers[i-1].attempts).to.be.at.least(s.topCardTiers[i].attempts); });
pm.test("peak hours: max 3, non-zero", () => { pm.expect(s.peakEntryHours.length).to.be.within(1,3); s.peakEntryHours.forEach(h => pm.expect(h.attempts).to.be.above(0)); });

item.name: 09 - Statement analysis (forecast eligibility from uploaded statements)
item.description: `POST /api/v1/statements/analyze` (multipart). Upload the last 3 months of card statements (Aug, Sep, Oct 2026) and get: whether the card is eligible for lounge access in the target month (November 2026), a spend/category/merchant analysis, and - if not eligible, or to stay eligible - exactly how much qualifying spend is needed in November so that December 2026 qualifies. Stateless: every request in this folder is independent, so the folder can be run on its own and in any order. **File upload:** the three files are attached with relative paths (`samples/statements/...`). In Postman set *Settings -> General -> Working directory* to the project root (or re-select the files in the Body tab). With Newman use `--working-dir <project root>`.

item.name: 9.1 Axis ACE - Aug/Sep/Oct statements qualify -> ELIGIBLE for Nov, plan to keep Dec

exec: pm.test("qualifying 66500 vs required 50000, surplus 16500", () => { pm.expect(j.qualifyingSpendInWindow).to.eql(66500); pm.expect(j.requiredSpend).to.eql(50000); pm.expect(j.surplusOrShortfall).to.eql(16500); pm.expect(j.progressPercent).to.eql(100); });
pm.test("all three months inside the window", () => pm.expect(j.monthlyBreakdown.every(m => m.includedInWindow && m.hasData)).to.be.true);

request.description:
**Purpose**
Happy path from the requirement: three Axis ACE statements with 66,500 qualifying spend. Cash (8,000), fuel (6,000), wallet reloads (3,000) and fees (590) are excluded.

**Preconditions**
**File upload:** the three files are attached with relative paths (`samples/statements/...`). In Postman set *Settings -> General -> Working directory* to the project root (or re-select the files in the Body tab). With Newman use `--working-dir <project root>`. Sample files: `samples/statements/axis_ace_eligible_aug_2026.csv`, `samples/statements/axis_ace_eligible_sep_2026.csv`, `samples/statements/axis_ace_eligible_oct_2026.csv`.

**Steps**
1. Open the Body tab (form-data) and confirm 3 `statements` files plus bank=AXIS, cardType=CREDIT, productCode=ACE, targetMonth=2026-11.
2. Click **Send**.
3. Read `summary` and `status` (ELIGIBLE), then `qualifyingSpendInWindow` (66500) vs `requiredSpend` (50000).
4. Read `monthlyBreakdown` (Aug 21,500 / Sep 26,300 / Oct 18,700 qualifying) and `excludedSpend` (17,590).
5. Read `planForUpcomingMonths`: December needs 5,000 more qualifying spend in November because August (21,500) drops out of the window.
6. Check the Test Results tab - all green.

**Expected result**
`eligibleForTargetMonth=true`, surplus 16,500, plan month 2026-12 needing 5,000 additional qualifying spend; quota 2 visits.

item.name: 9.2 Axis ACE - low qualifying spend -> NOT ELIGIBLE, steps for Nov to reach Dec

exec: pm.test("plan: Nov needs 29000 so that Dec qualifies", () => { const p = j.planForUpcomingMonths; pm.expect(p.planMonth).to.eql("2026-12"); pm.expect(p.spendAlreadyBanked).to.eql(21000); pm.expect(p.requiredSpend).to.eql(50000); pm.expect(p.additionalQualifyingSpendNeeded).to.eql(29000); pm.expect(p.perMonthTarget).to.eql(29000); pm.expect(p.perWeekTarget).to.be.above(6000); pm.expect(p.alreadySecured).to.be.false; });
pm.test("summary says NOT eligible and quotes the shortfall", () => { pm.expect(j.summary).to.include("NOT eligible"); pm.expect(j.summary).to.include("19,200"); });

pm.test("step-by-step recommendations", () => { pm.expect(j.recommendations.some(r => r.startsWith("Step 1") && r.includes("December 2026") && r.includes("29,000"))).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.recommendations.some(r => r.includes("Stop wasting spend"))).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.recommendations.some(r => r.includes("targetMonth=2026-12"))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("no refund warning in this data set", () => pm.expect(j.warnings.some(w => w.includes("Refunds"))).to.be.false);

request.description:
**Purpose**
The failure path from the requirement. Qualifying spend is only 30,800 because 36,000 (54%) went on fuel, wallet reloads and cash. The response explains why, and what to do in November so that December qualifies.

**Preconditions**
**File upload:** the three files are attached with relative paths (`samples/statements/...`). In Postman set *Settings -> General -> Working directory* to the project root (or re-select the files in the Body tab). With Newman use `--working-dir <project root>`. Sample files: `samples/statements/axis_ace_not_eligible_aug_2026.csv`, `samples/statements/axis_ace_not_eligible_sep_2026.csv`, `samples/statements/axis_ace_not_eligible_oct_2026.csv`.

**Steps**
1. Send the request (3 `not_eligible` files, Axis ACE, targetMonth 2026-11).
2. Read `summary`: NOT eligible, shortfall 19,200.
3. Read `excludedSpend` - fuel 18,000, wallet 10,000, cash 8,000 (53.9% of all spend) - this is *why* the card did not qualify.
4. Read `planForUpcomingMonths`: November spending cannot rescue November (window closed) but 29,000 of qualifying spend in November makes December eligible (Sep 12,400 + Oct 8,600 + Nov 29,000 = 50,000).
5. Follow `recommendations` Step 1..4 (what to spend, which categories count, what to stop, when to re-check).

**Expected result**
`status=NOT_ELIGIBLE`, shortfall -19,200, plan month 2026-12 with 29,000 additional qualifying spend (~6,698 per week).

item.name: 9.3 New card (issued Sep 2026) -> ELIGIBLE via new-card exception

exec: pm.test("spend itself is still below the threshold", () => { pm.expect(j.qualifyingSpendInWindow).to.eql(30800); pm.expect(j.surplusOrShortfall).to.eql(-19200); });
pm.test("recommendation mentions the exception end date", () => pm.expect(j.recommendations[0]).to.include("valid until 2026-12-31"));

request.description:
**Purpose**
HDFC credit cards use the PREVIOUS calendar quarter. For November 2026 that is Jul-Sep 2026; October and November spend cannot help November or December - the first month they count is January 2027 (window Oct-Dec).

**Preconditions**
**File upload:** the three files are attached with relative paths (`samples/statements/...`). In Postman set *Settings -> General -> Working directory* to the project root (or re-select the files in the Body tab). With Newman use `--working-dir <project root>`.

**Steps**
1. Send the request (same eligible Axis files, bank=HDFC, productCode=MILLENNIA).
2. Read the window: 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 (July is missing -> dataComplete=false).
3. Read `planForUpcomingMonths`: planMonth 2027-01, October (18,700) already banked, 81,300 needed over Nov + Dec (40,650 per month).
4. Read `followingMonthOutlook`: December's window is already closed.

**Expected result**
`NOT_ELIGIBLE`, window Jul-Sep, plan month 2027-01 needing 81,300.
